naz.translation: abbr. nazionale (Italian=national) （拉丁语）国家的，国立（有）的，民族的

nazar.translation: <兴都斯坦语> n.(尤指进见时的)礼物, 贡品

nazaree.definition:
A Bitch
> Nazaree is a bitch

nazarene.definition:
n. a member of a group of Jews who (during the early history of the Christian Church) accepted Jesus as the Messiah; they accepted the Gospel According to Matthew but rejected the Epistles of St. Paul and continued to follow Jewish law and celebrate Jewish holidays; they were later declared heretic by the Church of Rome
n. an early name for any Christian
n. an inhabitant of Nazareth
nazarene.translation: n. 拿撒勒人, 拿撒勒画派成员

nazareth.definition: n. a historic town in northern Israel that is mentioned in the Gospels as the home of Joseph and Mary
nazareth.translation: n. 拿撒勒(巴勒斯坦古城)

nazarite.definition:
n. A Jew bound by a vow to lave the hair uncut, to abstain
   from wine and strong drink, and to practice extraordinary purity of
   life and devotion, the obligation being for life, or for a certain
   time. The word is also used adjectively.
nazarite.translation: n. 修行者, 拿撒勒人

nazaritic.definition: a. Of or pertaining to a Nazarite, or to Nazarites.

nazaritism.definition: n. The vow and practice of a Nazarite.

naze.definition: n a cape at the southern tip of Norway

nazi.definition:
n. a German member of Adolf Hitler's political party
n. derogatory term for a person who is fanatically dedicated to, or seeks to control, some activity, practice, etc.
a. relating to or consistent with or typical of the ideology and practice of Nazism or the Nazis
nazi.translation:
n. 纳粹党人
a. 纳粹党的

nazi germany.translation: [网络] 纳粹德国；德国纳粹；德曼纳粹

nazi party.translation:
un. 〔政〕纳粹党
[网络] 德国纳粹党聚会；领导下的纳粹党；纳税派对

nazidom.translation: n. [亦作n-]纳粹政权, 纳粹思想和制度

nazification.definition: n. social process of adopting (or being forced to adopt) Nazism

nazified.translation: v. 使纳粹化( Nazify的过去式和过去分词 )

nazifies.translation: 使纳粹化（Nazify的第三人称单数形式）

nazify.definition: v. cause or force to adopt Nazism or a Nazi character

nazifying.definition: v cause or force to adopt Nazism or a Nazi character
nazifying.translation: v. 使纳粹化( Nazify的现在分词 )

naziism.definition: n a form of socialism featuring racism and expansionism and obedience to a strong leader
